references.name: whole-station-roofs.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary Scott Monument overview: complete broad pale glazed/pitched station roof field with repeated transverse gables,fine roof ribs, two long internal strips/openings with low stone passenger ranges, western classical arched entrances facing Waverley Bridge, and long south/Market Street stone frontage. Existing North Bridge spans above the eastern station. Separate Balmoral hotel, Waverley Market/green mall roof and independent buildings remain outside the station model. No buses,trains,brand signs,public artworks or neighboring blocks copied.

references.name: market-street-entrance.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected Market Street entrance from North Bridge: tall two-level stone station office at street edge, long stone station facade with repeated blind/relieved arches, modern curved glass-and-pale-metal entrance pavilion and rooflights, glazed pitched roofs over descending stairs/escalators to lower station, stone boundary piers and clear level changes between upper street and railway floor. Exact hidden entrances,roof framing and interior/service inventory remain approximate. Do not flatten this stepped station into one street-level slab.
